summary: End-to-end verification of the Annual NIRF Refresh Workflow (backend + frontend). Backend live-API regression (11/11 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_annual_refresh_api.py, ~55s including two full 7-stage runs): POST /api/admin/nirf/refresh {year:2026,category:Engineering,limit:25,simulate:true} returns job_id; polling GET /api/admin/nirf/refresh/jobs/{id} reaches status='Completed' within ~16-26s and stages array has exactly 7 entries all with status='done', data_origin is present, stats={institutions:15, downloaded, previous_year:2024, changes_tracked:15}. GET /api/admin/nirf/years?category=Engineering returns BOTH 2024 and 2026 (historical preserved). HISTORICAL PRESERVATION verified: GET /api/admin/nirf/derived-metrics?year=2024 still returns 15 records and the document_id sets for 2024 vs 2026 are disjoint (2026 created new docs, 2024 documents never overwritten); GET /api/admin/nirf/raw-data/{2024_doc_id} still returns the 2024 document. GET /api/admin/nirf/changes?year=2026 returns {changes:[15 rows], summary} with summary.previous_year=2024 and avg_salary_pct/avg_placement_delta_pp/avg_faculty_pct/data_origin/institutions all present; each row carries changes.median_salary/placement_rate/faculty_count each with current+previous+delta+pct_change+direction(up/down/flat/na). GET /api/admin/nirf/trends parametrized over metric=median_salary|placement_rate|faculty_count returns {years:[2024,2026], average:[{year,value}...], series:[{institute_id,college_name,points:[{year,value}]}]} for every metric; trends with metric='bogus_metric' returns HTTP 400. Idempotency confirmed: re-running the refresh for year=2026 keeps changes count at 15 (upsert, no duplicates). Module pytest /app/backend/tests/test_refresh.py 6/6 PASS (stages_are_seven, tracked_metrics, delta up/down/flat, pct-points deltas, missing values, value extractors). Frontend (real browser): /admin/nirf/refresh mounts data-testid='admin-refresh-page' with year selector defaulting to 2026 and 'Sync NIRF 2026' button; clicking data-testid='sync-nirf-btn' triggers the real workflow — refresh-stages panel appears immediately with all 7 stages, simulated-banner ('Upstream NIRF 2026 PDFs were unavailable - data simulated...') appears after ~26s, KPI tiles update (Institutions Tracked 15, Avg Salary Change +6.3%, Avg Placement Change +1 pp, Avg Faculty Change +2.3%), and a 'NIRF 2026 refresh complete' toast confirms completion. Changes table data-testid='changes-table' lists 15 institutions with data-testid='change-row-IR-E-{U|I}-####' (e.g. change-row-IR-E-U-0456 IIT Madras), each row shows Median Salary as Rupee value with +/-% delta (e.g. ₹17,34,370 +4.3%), Placement as percentage (81.2%) with 'pp' delta (-1.76 pp), and Faculty integer with +/-% delta (716 +5.1%); arrows + green/red coloring rendered correctly. Trends panel data-testid='trends-panel' renders a Recharts line chart and the three tabs trend-tab-median_salary / trend-tab-placement_rate / trend-tab-faculty_count each switch the charted metric (verified by Y-axis re-scaling - ₹18.0L for salary, percentage axis for placement, 0-1000 for faculty). Navigation round-trip: intel-to-refresh on /admin/nirf/intelligence navigates to /admin/nirf/refresh and refresh-to-intel returns to /admin/nirf/intelligence. Regression: /admin/nirf and /admin/nirf/metrics still load with their data-testid markers; /admin/nirf/review renders content (2285 chars body text) but uses a different page-level testid than 'admin-review-page' - non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: annual_refresh.py / server.py: the refresh job is stored in-memory (no persistence) per-process. If the backend supervisor restarts mid-job, polling GET /refresh/jobs/{id} will 404. Consider persisting job status to MongoDB so the UI can recover after a restart.

AdminRefresh.jsx poll loop: same pattern as the prior admin pages — silently retries indefinitely with no max-attempt cap. If the job_id 404s briefly or the network flaps, the UI spinner stays forever. Add a max-attempts ceiling (~60 polls / ~2min) and surface a user-visible error toast on terminal failure.

POST /api/admin/nirf/refresh: no concurrency guard — clicking 'Sync NIRF 2026' twice spawns two parallel workflows that both upsert to the same (year, category). Idempotency saves data integrity, but the second run wastes ~16s and double-fires the simulated-fallback. Consider returning the existing in-flight job_id when (year, category) is already running.

Trends endpoint: only the cohort 'average' line is rendered as a chart by default — the 'series' payload (per-institute lines) is fetched but not visualized in AdminRefresh.jsx. Either render a multi-series toggle or remove the unused payload to save bandwidth (15 series x 2 points = small now, but will balloon as years accumulate).

Simulated data labelling is excellent in the UI banner and changes summary, but the per-row changes payload does not carry data_origin='simulated' at the row level — downstream consumers (e.g. the Compare page) cannot tell which row's current value is simulated vs real. Consider stamping data_origin on each change row for traceability.
/admin/nirf/review page does not expose a stable page-level data-testid (e.g. 'admin-review-page'). Add it for consistent navigation/regression coverage with the other admin pages.
test_credentials: N/A - admin endpoints are open per spec; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present but not required for this feature.
seed_data_creation: Tests trigger two full refresh runs for year=2026/category=Engineering (idempotent upsert by institute_id+year+category). 15 nirf_change_tracking rows and 15 nirf_derived_metrics rows are created/upserted for 2026; 2024 data is left untouched (verified by document_id disjointness and unchanged 15-record count for year=2024).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Annual Refresh live-API regression: /app/backend/tests/test_annual_refresh_api.py - run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest backend/tests/test_annual_refresh_api.py -v`. Each invocation triggers two full ~16s simulated refresh runs (one for completion check + one for idempotency), so the suite takes ~55s. The derived-metrics endpoint returns {derived_metrics:[], count:N} (NOT a bare array or {records:[]}) - use the _rows() helper in the test file. The job_id is a UUID string and the polling endpoint returns the full job object including stages[]/stats/data_origin. The 'simulated' fallback fires for year=2026 because the NIRF live site returns 504 from this env - this is expected and visibly labelled in the UI banner. For Playwright on /admin/nirf/refresh, the stage rows do NOT use [data-testid^='stage-'] selectors - they render via the 7 fixed stage panels shown in the screenshot; the refresh-stages container testid is the reliable signal, and completion can be detected by the simulated-banner testid appearing or the 'NIRF 2026 refresh complete' toast. Trend tab clicks correctly re-render the Recharts SVG with a new Y-axis scale.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Initial test failures (3/11) on first run were due to my test assuming the derived-metrics endpoint returned {records:[]} or a bare array; the actual contract is {derived_metrics:[], count:N}. Fixed by adding a _rows() helper that handles all three shapes, then all 11 tests passed.
